deduplicationRule: Same semantic subsystem, trigger, failed assertion, and contract impact share one ID; timestamps, verifier context, and repeated rounds do not create duplicates.

findings.title: Browser visual interaction proof unavailable
findings.detail: Two browser-use attempts returned no structured report. Vite returned HTTP 200 and deterministic N7 sync/reset tests passed, but no screenshot, DOM interaction trace, or browser console capture exists.
findings.route: N9 human gate: rerun visual verification with functioning browser capture

findings.title: Exact reset equality rejected a valid tolerance result
findings.detail: The temporary adversarial probe observed [0, 2.799999952316284, 0] versus [0, 2.8, 0]. The difference is within repeatPosition tolerance 0.0005. Corrected tolerance-based probes passed all boundaries in two independent clean rounds.
findings.route: Discard exact-equality hypothesis; retain approved tolerance-based contract

findings.title: Browser FPS/frame-budget/physics-step metrics unmeasured
findings.detail: Headless test wall time and RSS do not prove sustained FPS, p95 frame time, sustained >33 ms frames, or average Rapier step cost. No browser Performance trace was captured.
findings.route: N9 human gate: obtain Chrome performance trace before claiming performance thresholds pass

findings.title: Production bundle exceeds Vite default warning size
findings.detail: Build succeeds, but the minified JS chunk is 3057.72 kB (gzip 1039.78 kB), triggering Vite's >500 kB warning. This is not an approved contract threshold.
findings.route: N9 human gate: decide whether to request a separately approved bundle-budget requirement; do not silently alter thresholds
